description: Football (soccer) data — standings, schedules, match stats, xG, transfers, player profiles. Covers 13 leagues: EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS, UCL, World Cup, Championship, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Serie A Brazil, Euro. Use when: football/soccer standings, fixtures, stats, xG, lineups, transfers, injury news, player profiles. Don't use for NFL (nfl-data), CFB (cfb-data), NBA (nba-data), WNBA (wnba-data), CBB (cbb-data), NHL (nhl-data), MLB (mlb-data), tennis (tennis-data), golf (golf-data), F1 (fastf1), or betting (polymarket/kalshi). No live scores. get_season_leaders/get_missing_players: EPL only. get_event_xg: top 5 leagues only.
